name: project-sor
description: Source-backed Schedule of Reductions calculations and scenario review through a read-only remote MCP server.

interface.longDescription: An educational financial-aid tool for students and aid staff to review supported Direct Loan Schedule of Reductions scenarios. Run source-backed estimates, compare cases, and identify missing facts or issues that need school review. Results are estimates, not award or eligibility determinations. Schools must verify loan history, aggregate limits, COD status, and final packaging requirements. Project SOR is independent and is not endorsed by the U.S. Department of Education.
